title: GrowthBook case-study cards
description: A pale lavender band framed by thin rules: a big three-line heading with an outline button opposite, then a swipeable row of deep violet-black story cards (customer wordmark, one-line story, a big result figure, a mono read-more link) that advances by itself. Wordmarks sharpen from a blur as they come into view; a multicolour light travels down the left rule.
notes: the cards force the dark tokens (class dark): card is the violet-black surface
carousel uses growthbook-track (autoplay every 4.5s, off with reduced motion); the blur-in is CSS scroll-driven
name: growthbook-case-studies
